name: XIX!
source:
Young treasure hunter Zion found an orb in the ancient ruins and a girl came out of it. She needed to confirm something in the labyrinth beneath the ruins and Zion could not leave her alone there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-november-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
年轻的宝藏猎人锡安在远古废墟中发现了一个球体，一个女孩从里面走了出来。她需要确认废墟下迷宫里的某些东西，锡安不能把她一个人留在那里。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-november-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
